title: How imgen turns a prompt into an image
description: You pass a prompt and a model. imgen resolves the model's latest version on Replicate and reads its input schema. From the schema it decides how to send the size: exact width and height through a custom aspect ratio, the closest allowed aspect ratio, or plain width and height. It then creates a prediction, polls until it has finished, downloads the image and saves it as PNG or WebP.
source: src/main.rs (resolve_model, build_input, create_prediction, poll_prediction, download_image), as of 2026-10-26
